story_busy.text: Busy. That sloop at the end of the dock won't plank herself. Come back when Odile says you're worth my time.

text: Odile sent you? Then you're the one who did for Grell. Huh. Thought you'd be taller.
The sloop. Aye, she could be yours. Hull's sound, rigging's new. But her keel's half rot, and oak won't do for what's out past the reef.
What I need is chitin. Brood chitin, off the queen bug nesting in the cave in the deep forest, west of the ruins. Harder than iron, and it never rots.
Bring me the queen's shell and I'll lay you a keel the Sea King couldn't bite through. Then she's yours.

story_queen.text: The queen's in the cave in the deep forest, west of the ruins. Bring a bigger blade than you think you need.

text: Is that... that's her shell. You actually did it.
Give me a moment. There. Keel's laid, she's caulked and tarred. She's yours, {captain}. Board her at the end of Odile's dock and take the helm with F.
And when you've some gold, come back. Iron, guns, canvas, paint. I'll make her into something the sea respects.
That sloop at the end of Odile's dock yours, {captain}? She's sound. Plain, but sound.
I'm Tackett. I build 'em, I mend 'em, and for a fair price I make 'em into something the sea respects.

choices.text: Let's see what you can do for her.
What sort of work do you do?

yard.text: Right. Let's have a look at her.

text: Iron straps on her planks, so a cannonball has to work for it. A third pair of guns aft. More canvas. A rudder that answers.
And paint, flags, a figurehead to scare the fish. Paint's free, mind. A captain should fly her own colours.

bye.text: Bring me gold and I'll bring you a warship.
